role: causal development with independent unit target profiles
registration_context: V3, V4, component and local action diagnostics observed; all 23 inverse-target reconstructions succeed; no V5 whole-window rollout outcomes observed
unchanged_contract: inherit V3 asset, independent unit capacity, efficiency, common initial stocks, forecast calibration, receipt priority, lead time, physical execution, failure event and cost accounting; V4 empirical reserve rules remain unused

candidate_mapping.component_library: the exact original 64 V3 component profiles, seed 20261799, 128 generator nodes, maximum frequency 40, 1000 interpolated nodes and 100 integer levels
candidate_mapping.constant_pairs: all 10x10 ordered pairs of original constant components profile_0000 through profile_0009
candidate_mapping.functional_pairs: for each i=10,...,63, use original component i for unit 1 and component 10+((i-10+27) mod 54) for unit 2; this includes the swapped partner of every pair
candidate_mapping.ordering: 100 constant pairs in unit-1-major row order, followed by 54 functional pairs in original component index order
candidate_mapping.representation: two separate ordered 1000-node integer channels, concatenated as a 2000-coordinate policy; interpolate each unit's channel only on its own forecast stress input
candidate_mapping.no_witness_targets: inverse-target fractions and perfect-information schedules do not enter the library or any controller decision
candidate_mapping.selection: fixed structural mapping; no pairing score, random seed change, target-level addition, outcome-based profile pruning or parameter search

control.target: each unit independently evaluates its assigned original component at the same available delivery forecast stress and targets its resulting fraction times 98 MWh
control.projection: unchanged V3 actual stocks, two pending nominations and received-only 90-minute BOA projection
control.nomination: unchanged nominate_units with a two-component target; retain known future headroom clipping and joint 98 MW absolute nomination normalization
control.information: delivery and preceding forecasts published by nomination time; only BOAs already received, actual stocks and already pending plans; prices and future receipts remain unavailable
control.engine: extend simulate_units to accept independent per-unit target arrays; existing shared-target callers continue to represent equal channels

roster.development_samples: all original April, July and October 2024 ten-day samples
roster.reuse: diagonal constant pairs reproduce original V3 constant profiles; reuse their 10x219 saved rows and the three shared reference rows, with explicit provenance. Do not rerun the V3 controller matrix

validation: verify that equal target channels preserve the existing shared-target engine behavior and that unequal channels reach the correct units without shifting nomination timing
a future unreceived BOA must not alter an earlier two-unit nomination
evaluate all new profiles and every original complete window, preserving stopped-window failures
report new and reused window counts separately, April/July/October feasibility and the common feasible library set
gate: retain the original 95% finite-window criterion: at least one joint library candidate succeeds in at least 70/73 windows in each sample, and at least one joint library candidate is unsafe. A pass directs only registration of a source-archive pilot; full source comparison remains HOLD
comparison_scope: V5 enlarges the joint candidate set from 64 to 154 while preserving all original component profiles; any whole-window feasibility gain cannot be attributed solely to target decoupling using the old 64-profile matrix
cost_scope: use inherited metered procurement and terminal adjustment only on completed windows; conditional completed-window cost does not rank methods with different failure sets
limitations: development-selected control and library repair, overlapping windows and fixed historical BOAs; local representability does not establish whole-window success, source benefit, measured battery performance or independent confirmation
